title: bicoeff

messages.description: filter type: allpass, lowpass, highpass, bandpass, resonant, bandstop, eq, lowshelf or highshelf

methods.description: nonzero saves the filter settings with the patch

body: [bicoeff] is a GUI that generates coefficients for vanilla's [biquad~] according to different filter types ("eq" filter by default). Click on it and drag it around.
